dose_rules.original_text: Administer orally at a rate to provide 5-20 mg/kg (2.27 to 9.07 mg/lb) of body weight. Selection of a dose within the range should be based on clinical experience, the severity of disease, and susceptibility of the pathogen.

contraindications.original_text: Enrofloxacin is contraindicated in dogs and cats known to be hypersensitive to quinolones.

contraindications.condition: цуценята дрібних та середніх порід у фазі швидкого росту (2-8 місяців)
contraindications.original_text: The use of enrofloxacin is contraindicated in small and medium breeds of dogs during the rapid growth phase (between 2 and 8 months of age). The safe use of enrofloxacin has not been established in large and giant breeds during the rapid growth phase.

contraindications.condition: перевищення дози 5 мг/кг/добу - ризик ретинальної токсичності
contraindications.original_text: In rare instances, use of this product in cats has been associated with Retinal Toxicity. Do not exceed 5 mg/kg of body weight per day in cats. Safety in breeding or pregnant cats has not been established.

contraindications.condition: відомі або підозрювані розлади центральної нервової системи
contraindications.original_text: Quinolone-class drugs should be used with caution in animals with known or suspected Central Nervous System (CNS) disorders. In such animals, quinolones have, in rare instances, been associated with CNS stimulation which may lead to convulsive seizures.
